nodes.label: Portfolio Photo: Bedroom with Desk and City View
nodes.description: Completed residential interior renovation — bedroom. Scandinavian/minimalist style. Light beige/grey plastered walls, engineered oak hardwood flooring, wall-mounted flat-screen TV, built-in ceiling track lighting rail, single large window with soft pink linen curtains overlooking urban high-rise cityscape. White desk with drawer unit, grey upholstered chair, double bed with grey upholstered frame and blue accent pillow. Renovation stage: fully finished and furnished. Location type: residential apartment, high floor, urban.

nodes.label: Portfolio Photo: Master Bedroom with Wardrobe and AC Unit
nodes.description: Completed residential interior renovation — master bedroom, alternate angle. Likely same apartment as ph-0003 (matching grey upholstered bed, blue accent pillows, white desk and grey chair visible at right edge, identical engineered oak flooring, same grey-beige plastered walls, ceiling track lighting). Additional elements visible: large floor-to-ceiling white hinged wardrobe (4 panels), wall-mounted split air conditioning unit, nightstand with small lamp. Renovation stage: fully finished and furnished. Location type: residential apartment, urban.

nodes.label: Portfolio Photo: Bathroom with Stone-Effect Tiles and Walnut Vanity
nodes.description: Completed residential interior renovation — bathroom/WC. Contemporary modern style. Full-height large-format grey stone-effect ceramic tiles on walls and floor. Custom LED indirect cove lighting strip along ceiling perimeter and backlit mirror. Wall-mounted toilet with dark green push-plate flush panel. Vessel sink (white ceramic bowl) on walnut-veneer drawer unit with open shelf below holding towels. Backlit rectangular mirror with black metal frame. Polished chrome tap. Partial view of white bathtub alcove on left. Renovation stage: fully finished and furnished. Location type: residential apartment.
